_what_this_is: The venue's OWN soccer board, read through /api/admin/desk-game (which applies copy_sports.market_type_of) for three sampled soccer events. Captured because the previous report's `aec|atc` prefix test counted the money-line FAMILY and could not establish the payout event, and because binding a probability before establishing that event is the category error this evidence prevents.

sample._this_is_a_sample: 3 of 267. It cannot establish what the whole board contains, and no claim here does.

what_this_establishes: THE PAYOUT EVENT IS A BINARY, NOT A THREE-WAY LINE. Each us_slug appears TWICE, labelled '— Y' and '— N'. The three outcomes (home / draw / away) are three SEPARATE yes/no contracts, not one three-way money line. A de-vigged three-outcome probability does not price a single one of them without restating which event it is on.

THE COMPETITION IS NOT THE ONE THE SOURCE PRICES. Every league token is `ebfpl` and the labels say 'eBattles' -- a simulated/esports football competition. The connected provider sport is `soccer_epl`, the REAL English Premier League. The team names coincide; the competitions do not. Binding a real-EPL probability to an `ebfpl` contract on a name match would be a cross-competition category error.
NO BARE FULL-MATCH SLUG APPEARS. Every slug in the sample carries a `dh2`/`dh3` qualifier. Nothing in this sample is the unqualified full-match contract.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: That the venue lists no real-EPL money line anywhere. 3 of 267 soccer events were read.
What `dh2`/`dh3` denote. They are recorded verbatim and not interpreted; the reading above rests on the LABELS and the league token, not on a guess about those tokens.
That any soccer contract is or is not settlement-compatible. No soccer prose has been read on either side, so soccer settlement remains UNKNOWN.
corrects_a_previous_report: The handoff's 'the venue sells 997 soccer events with 838 sides under its own money-line prefixes, so this is our ingestion gap' over-counted and mis-attributed. Those sides are eBattles binaries. On this sample the cause is MISSING VENUE COVERAGE OF THE COMPETITION THE SOURCE PRICES, not our ingestion, and `NO_VENUE_CONTRACT_FOR_EVENT` on 20 of 20 EPL fixtures was the CORRECT refusal.
the_next_bounded_read: The same route over the WHOLE soccer board, reporting the league-token histogram: it answers 'does the venue list the real EPL or Liga MX at all' with counts instead of a 3-event sample. No new resolver and no new model.
